content.user_title: Control Philips Hue Lights with OpenHue
content.value_statement: Managing Hue lights from an AI assistant can require exact CLI syntax. This skill provides OpenHue command guidance for listing resources, controlling rooms, and setting scenes.
actual_capabilities: Lists OpenHue commands for lights, rooms, and scenes.
Shows how to turn Hue lights on and off by name.
Provides brightness, color, RGB, and color temperature command patterns.
Supports room-level controls for on, off, and brightness changes.
Includes preset examples for bedtime, work, and movie lighting.
limitations: Requires the OpenHue CLI to be installed and available.
Requires a Philips Hue Bridge on the local network.
First use requires physical bridge pairing.
Color commands only work on color-capable Hue bulbs.

use_cases.title: Adjust Room Lighting
use_cases.description: Turn rooms on or off and set brightness with OpenHue commands.

use_cases.title: Activate Hue Scenes
use_cases.description: Run named Hue scenes for rooms such as Relax or Concentrate.

use_cases.title: Build Lighting Presets
use_cases.description: Create repeatable commands for bedtime, work mode, and movie mode.

prompt_templates.title: List Available Lights
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me the OpenHue commands to list my lights, rooms, and scenes.

prompt_templates.title: Control One Light
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me turn Bedroom Lamp on and set it to 50 percent brightness with OpenHue.

prompt_templates.title: Set a Room Scene
prompt_templates.prompt: Give me the OpenHue command to activate the Concentrate scene in my Office.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Lighting Preset
prompt_templates.prompt: Create OpenHue commands for a movie preset in Living Room with dim warm lighting.

output_examples.output: The assistant provides an OpenHue room command that targets Bedroom and sets it to off.
The assistant suggests a bright, cool Office room command using OpenHue brightness and temperature options.
The assistant gives an OpenHue scene command that activates Relax for the Bedroom room.

best_practices: Confirm the exact Hue light, room, or scene name before running a command.
Pair the Hue Bridge before asking the assistant to control lights.
Use room commands for groups and light commands for individual bulbs.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for non-Hue smart devices.
Do not expect color settings on white-only bulbs.
Do not use it for HomeKit scenes, thermostats, TVs, or smart plugs outside Hue.

faq.question: Does this skill install OpenHue CLI?
faq.answer: It includes metadata for installing OpenHue CLI with Homebrew, but the CLI must be available before commands can run.

faq.question: Does it work without a Hue Bridge?
faq.answer: No. The skill expects a Philips Hue Bridge on the local network.

faq.question: Can it control individual lights?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents commands for individual lights by name.

faq.question: Can it control rooms?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes room commands for power and brightness.

faq.question: Can it set colors?
faq.answer: Yes, for color-capable bulbs. It shows color name, RGB, and temperature examples.

faq.question: Does it support other smart home brands?
faq.answer: No. It is focused on Philips Hue devices through OpenHue CLI.
